column1: # Species traits for the trait-space (PCA) view. One row per species name (matches manifest/species.tsv `species`).
# invasion: invasive   = GISD account as an alien, or >= 1 WRiMS locality flagged invasive / of concern
#           introduced = non-native records (WRiMS alien, or GISD listing without account) but none flagged invasive
#           native     = marine/brackish species with no non-native records
#           uncertain  = not enough information to assign
#           Species outside both databases (most insects, freshwater mussels) keep the general-knowledge label (source column).
# source: which database(s) set the label (rule in scripts/check_invasion_dbs.py); 'general knowledge' = species outside GISD and outside WRiMS scope (terrestrial/freshwater).
# evidence: database hits; label_general_knowledge: the earlier label drafted 2026-11-27; notes: common name and context.
